"I wasn't one of those people who knew from an early age that they wanted to be an animator and spent their childhood preparing for it," Zhang recalled. "I felt I could never catch up with them. But Michael taught me that what matters most is having a great idea and strong design."

Following three years at Sony Pictures Animation, Zhang went on to join Walt Disney Animation Studios, widely regarded as the {{15}} of the animation industry. After working on {{16}} films including Big Hero 6, Zootopia and Moana, he chose to leave Disney and pursue his {{17}} {{18}} by founding his own company, Taiko Studios.
paragraphs.cn: “我不是那种从小就知道自己想成为动画师并花童年为之准备的人，”张少甫回忆道。“我觉得自己永远赶不上他们。但迈克尔教会我，最重要的是拥有一个好主意和扎实的设计。”在索尼动画公司工作三年后，张少甫加入了被广泛视为动画行业巅峰的华特迪士尼动画工作室。在参与制作了《超能陆战队》、《疯狂动物城》和《海洋奇缘》等备受赞誉的电影后，他选择离开迪士尼，通过创立自己的公司“太酷工作室”来追求创业抱负。

paragraphs.en:
Why? After moving to the US, it wasn't until 2010 that Zhang had his first real opportunity to return to China. He realized that China is truly very different from the US and that there are so many opportunities here. "It started to feel like coming home," Zhang recalled. "I wanted to build a Chinese animation studio and use what I had learned at Disney to help support Chinese animation."
Zhang and his founding partners, including Andrew Chesworth and Bobby Pontillas, wanted to create a story about a young girl {{19}} to reach the stars.
paragraphs.cn: 为什么？移居美国后，直到2010年张少甫才第一次真正有机会回到中国。他意识到中国与美国确实非常不同，这里有很多机会。“开始有回家的感觉了，”张少甫回忆道。“我想建立一家中国动画工作室，并利用我在迪士尼学到的东西来帮助支持中国动画。”张少甫和他的创始合伙人，包括安德鲁·切斯沃思和鲍比·庞蒂利亚斯，想创作一个关于一个决心触及星辰的小女孩的故事。

paragraphs.en: That {{20}} became "One Small Step," an animated short about chasing dreams against all odds. A photo shows a meeting between Zhang Shaofu and his team at a restaurant after they left the Disney Animation Studios in California, US. Some elements of the story were {{21}} by Zhang's own childhood in the US. Shortly after his family {{22}}, his mother opened a tailor shop to help support the household. Zhang {{23}} that memory into the character of Chu, Luna's father, who supports his daughter's dream of becoming an astronaut by running a shoe repair business out of his garage.
paragraphs.cn: 这个愿景变成了《冲破天际》，一部关于不顾一切追逐梦想的动画短片。一张照片显示了张少甫和他的团队在离开美国加利福尼亚州迪士尼动画工作室后在一家餐厅的会面。故事的一些元素受到了张少甫自己在美国童年的启发。在他家人移民后不久，他的母亲开了一家裁缝店来帮助维持家庭生计。张少甫将这段记忆转化为角色楚，露娜的父亲，他通过经营车库里的修鞋生意来支持女儿成为宇航员的梦想。

"I believe writers should write what they know. I think that's often about family," Zhang said. "If something feels real to me, others will feel the same way, like they've experienced something similar."

"One Small Step" has won over 200 awards at international film festivals, including a {{24}} for Best Short Film at the 90th Academy Awards. The success of "One Small Step" was followed by other animated projects, such as "Pangu" and "Fu," both of which draw inspiration from Chinese history, {{25}} and culture. As he worked on these projects, Zhang also immersed himself in the study of traditional Chinese culture.

paragraphs.en: Having grown up in the US, he was not deeply familiar with China's cultural {{26}}. Through these projects, however, he watched numerous Chinese films and explored a wide range of mythological stories. The more he learned, the more he felt that China's over 5,000 years of history offered an endless wealth of {{27}} and {{28}} stories waiting to be told. Reflecting on China's rich cultural heritage, Zhang recalled "Journey to the West" – one of the country's most beloved classics – as his favorite childhood story. Later, as he explored the deeper layers of Chinese mythology, a new figure captured his attention: the demon hunter, Zhong Kui.
paragraphs.cn: 由于在美国长大，他并不深入了解中国的文化遗产。然而，通过这些项目，他观看了大量中国电影，并探索了广泛的神话故事。他学得越多，就越觉得中国五千多年的历史提供了取之不尽、用之不竭的深刻而引人入胜的故事等待被讲述。回顾中国丰富的文化遗产，张少甫回忆起《西游记》——中国最受喜爱的经典之一——是他童年最喜欢的故事。后来，当他探索中国神话的更深层次时，一个新的人物吸引了他的注意：捉鬼的钟馗。

"At the beginning, Zhong Kui's story is one of tragedy and failure. But after he transitions from the human world to the underworld, he is given a second chance. paragraphs.en: The gaming industry is fiercely competitive, both in China and globally. For Zhang and his team, carving out space for their latest project is no easy task. Zhang Shaofu demonstrates a character's posture during a company meeting. "I'm responsible for both the production and creative direction of our project," Zhang said.
paragraphs.cn: 游戏行业竞争激烈，无论是在中国还是全球。几乎每周都有新游戏在各种类型中推出，这使得任何新游戏越来越难以脱颖而出并在市场中占据一席之地。对于张少甫和他的团队来说，为他们的最新项目开辟空间并非易事。张少甫在公司会议上演示一个角色的姿势。“我负责我们项目的制作和创意方向，”张少甫说。

paragraphs.en:
"That means I provide feedback on nearly everything, from visual design to gameplay. Approving levels and other key creative decisions is also part of my job."
Beyond the creative process, Zhang must also tackle a constant stream of challenges, ranging from technical hurdles to staffing issues. As soon as one problem is solved, another seems to take its place. Zhang Shaofu discusses a character's motion with an employee. "But we never let any of that get in the way of our dreams and our goals.
paragraphs.cn: “这意味着我几乎对所有事情提供反馈，从视觉设计到游戏玩法。批准关卡和其他关键创意决策也是我工作的一部分。”除了创意过程，张少甫还必须应对源源不断的挑战，从技术难题到人员问题。一个问题刚解决，另一个似乎又接踵而至。张少甫与一名员工讨论角色的动作。“但我们从未让任何这些阻碍我们的梦想和目标。无论如何，我都会完成它，”张少甫坚定地说。对于张少甫来说，无论是通过动画还是游戏，使命始终如一：抓住每一个机会，克服每一个困难，永不停止追求卓越。

paragraphs.en: No matter what, I'll get it done," Zhang said firmly. For Zhang, whether through animation or gaming, the mission is unwavering: take every chance, push through every difficulty and never stop striving for excellence.

articles.title: Tianjin boosts status as BCI powerhouse
articles.titleCn: 天津提升其脑机接口产业重镇地位
articles.summary: A dedicated industrial cluster for brain-computer interface was recently inaugurated in Tianjin, which will greatly accelerate the large-scale industrial application of research achievements in noninvasive BCI technologies, experts said.
articles.summaryCn: 天津通过建立产业集群、发布行动计划并依托完整产业链，加速非侵入式脑机接口技术的规模化应用。

paragraphs.en: A dedicated industrial cluster for brain-computer interface was recently {{0}} in Tianjin, which will greatly {{1}} the large-scale industrial application of research achievements in noninvasive BCI technologies, experts said. Tianjin recently released the action plan for promoting innovative development of brain-computer interface (2026-30). The document sets a goal to {{2}} 50 {{3}} innovative enterprises by 2027 and expand the large-scale use of BCI products in healthcare, education, advanced manufacturing and other sectors. Under the blueprint, Tianjin will build an industrial fund group worth over 10 billion yuan ($1.48 billion) by 2030, and push more than 10 types of noninvasive BCI products into {{4}} clinical use. "BCI has become a core {{5}} for global technological competition, as major countries are striving to build their own technological competitiveness," said Ni Guangjian, executive deputy director of the Haihe Laboratory of Brain-Computer Interaction and Human-Machine Integration.
paragraphs.cn: 专家表示，天津近日启用了专门的脑机接口产业集群，这将极大加速非侵入式脑机接口技术研究成果的大规模产业化应用。天津发布了《天津市促进脑机接口创新发展行动方案（2026-2030年）》。该文件设定了到2027年培育50家具有竞争力的创新企业的目标，并扩大脑机接口产品在医疗、教育、先进制造等领域的规模化应用。根据蓝图，天津将在2030年前建成规模超过100亿元人民币的产业基金群，并推动10种以上非侵入式脑机接口产品进入大规模临床应用。海河实验室执行副主任倪广健表示：“脑机接口已成为全球科技竞争的核心领域，主要国家都在努力构建自身的技术竞争力。”

paragraphs.en: The laboratory holds three world records and manages the world's largest patent {{6}} in the field. He said Tianjin's noninvasive BCI technology has reached world-class standards, thanks to a full industrial chain {{7}} research and development to real-world applications — built up over the past decade. "Tianjin's unique strength lies in its complete industrial {{8}}, covering every link from electrodes, algorithms and core chips to system integration and application demonstration," Ni added. paragraphs.cn: 该实验室在该领域拥有三项世界纪录和全球最大的专利组合。他表示，得益于过去十年建立起来的从研发到实际应用的完整产业链，天津的非侵入式脑机接口技术已达到世界一流水平。倪广健补充道：“天津的独特优势在于其完整的产业生态系统，覆盖了从电极、算法、核心芯片到系统集成和应用示范的每一个环节。”该市还拥有顶尖的人才储备。早在2024年，天津大学就开设了国内首个专注于脑机接口的本科专业。

paragraphs.en: Benefiting from the sound business environment and efficient {{9}} channels in the high-tech zone of Tianjin Binhai New Area, nearly 20 upstream and downstream enterprises have gathered in the zone, forming a complete industrial cluster covering hardware R&D, software development and system integration. Tiankai Suishi (Tianjin) Intelligent Technology Co — a key enterprise {{10}} by the laboratory and founded in 2023 — has developed BCI-based medical devices and treatment solutions that are now available at dozens of hospitals across more than 10 provincial-level regions nationwide, said Gu Bin, general manager of the company. One noteworthy clinical case involves a stroke patient with {{11}} on the right side of the body. During BCI {{12}} training, the system captured the patient's motor imagery to operate rehab equipment. After treatment, the patient could turn over independently, and basic motor function has been restored in the right leg.

A dedicated industrial cluster for brain-computer interface was recently inaugurated in Tianjin, which will greatly accelerate the large-scale industrial application of research achievements in noninvasive BCI technologies, experts said.
Tianjin recently released the action plan for promoting innovative development of brain-computer interface (2026-30). The document sets a goal to cultivate 50 competitive innovative enterprises by 2027 and expand the large-scale use of BCI products in healthcare, education, advanced manufacturing and other sectors.
Under the blueprint, Tianjin will build an industrial fund group worth over 10 billion yuan ($1.48 billion) by 2030, and push more than 10 types of noninvasive BCI products into extensive clinical use. "BCI has become a core arena for global technological competition, as major countries are striving to build their own technological competitiveness," said Ni Guangjian, executive deputy director of the Haihe Laboratory of Brain-Computer Interaction and Human-Machine Integration.
The laboratory holds three world records and manages the world's largest patent portfolio in the field. He said Tianjin's noninvasive BCI technology has reached world-class standards, thanks to a full industrial chain spanning research and development to real-world applications — built up over the past decade.
"Tianjin's unique strength lies in its complete industrial ecosystem, covering every link from electrodes, algorithms and core chips to system integration and application demonstration," Ni added.
The city also boasts top-tier talent reserves. Back in 2024, Tianjin University launched the country's first undergraduate academic program dedicated to BCI. Benefiting from the sound business environment and efficient commercialization channels in the high-tech zone of Tianjin Binhai New Area, nearly 20 upstream and downstream enterprises have gathered in the zone, forming a complete industrial cluster covering hardware R&D, software development and system integration.
Tiankai Suishi (Tianjin) Intelligent Technology Co — a key enterprise incubated by the laboratory and founded in 2023 — has developed BCI-based medical devices and treatment solutions that are now available at dozens of hospitals across more than 10 provincial-level regions nationwide, said Gu Bin, general manager of the company.
One noteworthy clinical case involves a stroke patient with paralysis on the right side of the body. During BCI rehabilitation training, the system captured the patient's motor imagery to operate rehab equipment.
After treatment, the patient could turn over independently, and basic motor function has been restored in the right leg. The technology reconnects human thoughts and physical movements, enabling paralyzed limbs to move under the patient's own commands rather than external assistance.
Gu said BCI delivers value across multiple scenarios. In mental health, it supports screening and treatment for depression. In critical care, it enables rapid diagnosis for conditions such as hydrocephalus — the abnormal buildup of cerebrospinal fluid.

The Chinese Academy of Sciences launched the "Black Soil Granary" science and technology initiative, bringing together 98 institutions nationwide to tackle key challenges in black soil protection. /CMG
The Chinese Academy of Sciences (CAS) on Monday announced a series of achievements made over the past five years in black soil conservation and utilization, including theoretical breakthroughs, technological innovations, model development and the research and development of advanced agricultural equipment.
In 2021, CAS launched the "Black Soil Granary" science and technology initiative, bringing together 98 institutions nationwide to tackle key challenges in black soil protection. The program forms an important part of China's strategy to safeguard food security through both arable land conservation and technological innovation.
After five years of research, the initiative has produced a range of landmark results and established a comprehensive solution framework spanning scientific research, product and equipment development, key technologies, integrated farming models, demonstration projects and large-scale application. The achievements provide strong scientific support for the sustainable use of China's black soil resources and national food security.
According to Jiang Ming, commander of the initiative, and director of the Northeast Institute of Geography and Agroecology, researchers have identified the major degradation trends affecting China's black soil over the past four decades, including thinning topsoil, declining fertility and increasing soil compaction.
The team also uncovered key mechanisms for improving soil fertility, developed technologies for targeted soil degradation control, gully erosion restoration, biologically enhanced soil health management and intelligent agricultural machinery, and established region-specific conservation and utilization models covering major black soil areas.
As part of the project, seven core demonstration zones of more than 10,000 mu (about 667 hectares) each have been established, with a combined demonstration area of 193,500 mu. In typical black soil regions, the technologies have increased soil organic matter content by 0.25 to 0.70 percentage points, reduced soil erosion by 80%, improved farmland quality by half a grade and boosted grain yields by more than 5.2%.
The technologies and management models have been extended to more than 540 million mu of farmland nationwide, providing solid scientific support for black soil protection and sustainable agricultural development.
The initiative has also addressed the growing demand for large-scale and intelligent agricultural machinery in northeast China. Researchers independently developed the third-generation "Honghu" series of intelligent agricultural machinery systems, with more than 90% of key components produced domestically.
The project achieved three major technological breakthroughs. Researchers developed a high-power electric motor system with an efficiency of 98.7% for a 400-horsepower motor, surpassing leading international benchmarks. They also established a high-strength, wear-resistant materials system and developed components that outperform comparable imported products.
The machinery has already been deployed across more than 30,000 mu of farmland in northeast China's black soil region, helping advance the modernization and sustainability of agricultural production.

萨默维尔从右翼内切，绕过套边插上的丹泽尔·邓弗里斯，左脚射门击中门柱内侧入网，日本门将铃木彩艳鞭长莫及。日本队的镰田大地（右）在2026年6月14日于德克萨斯州阿灵顿举行的2026年国际足联世界杯F组比赛中头球攻门。日本队需要再次做出回应，主帅森保一通过使用全部五个换人名额调整阵容，蓝武士逐渐加大进攻压力。这些换人调整帮助亚洲球队扭转了场上势头，日本队在比赛末段将荷兰队的防线一步步压回本方半场。努力在比赛还剩两分钟时收到回报。伊东纯也开出的角球首先被替补上场的小川航基争到，他的头球蹭到镰田大地后从维尔布鲁根手中滑脱，后者只能眼睁睁看着皮球被自己碰进荷兰队球门。

日本队的终场前扳平比分确保两队各取一分，为F组开局画上句号。这一结果进一步巩固了蓝武士在世界杯赛场上坚韧不拔的声誉，同时也让荷兰队未能取得开门红。
